Export saves to a zip, import one back, or sync them through a private GitHub Gist.
Back up your saves to your own GitHub account
%1$s stores backups in one secret GitHub Gist in your own account. Nothing is uploaded until you press Upload, and nothing leaves this device until you connect a token.

1. Open GitHub and sign in.
2. Create a fine-grained personal access token.
3. Expiration: about 366 days.
4. Repository access: leave at “Public repositories” -- none is needed.
5. Account permissions → Gists → Read and write. That one permission is all it needs.
6. Copy the token (GitHub shows it once) and paste it below.
Connected as %1$s. Your gist is created by your first Upload.
⚠ The token could not be saved to this device, so you will have to paste it again next time. This session works normally.
Gist %1$s · secret (unlisted, not private -- anyone with the link can read it)
No gist yet. Your first Upload creates one, unlisted, in your own account.
This uploads a bundle of the %1$d save file(s) on this device. Add a note so you can tell backups apart.
There are no saves on this device yet. Download still works, and it is how you would restore one.
Up to date -- these saves are already in %1$s, so nothing was uploaded.
This replaces the saves on this device with %1$d file(s) from the cloud. The game folder currently holds %2$d.
Restored %1$d save file(s). Your previous saves are kept as %2$s.
You can still download it: the bundle is checked for being a readable save bundle either way, and it is refused if it is not. Only the “was this changed outside the launcher” check is skipped.

This removes %1$s from your GitHub gist.

This cannot be undone from here. There is no trash can to get it back from.

The saves on this device are not touched.

This removes the token from this device.\n\nIt does NOT delete your cloud backups and it does NOT revoke the token -- revoke it yourself on GitHub if you want it dead. Pasting a new token from the same account brings the same backups straight back.
This deletes the whole gist from your GitHub account, including every backup in it, and then removes the token from this device.
Every cloud backup will be gone. This cannot be undone.\n\nThe saves on this device are not touched.
Disconnected. Your cloud backups are untouched.
Cloud data deleted and token removed from this device.
⚠ GitHub is still serving an older copy of your cloud index than this device last wrote. What you see may be out of date -- press Refresh in a moment.
Something went wrong. Your saves on this device were not changed.
Edit the token on GitHub and set Account permissions → Gists → Read and write.
Cloud features need an internet connection; everything else in the game works without one.
Check you copied the whole token -- GitHub only shows it once. If it expired or was deleted, create a new one.
No browser is available on this device. The address is: %1$s

The gist is secret, which means unlisted -- not private. Anyone who has its URL can read it, so do not share the URL. The token is stored on this device only, is excluded from Android Auto Backup, and is obfuscated rather than hardware-encrypted.
No saves yet -- play the game and save first.
%1$d save file(s) will go into the bundle.

A bundle is a zip of every save file in the game folder matching the configured pattern. Machine-local settings files are deliberately left out -- they are a setting, not progress. Import auto-detects a zip or a base64 cloud payload, validates it before anything is written, and keeps your current saves as pre-import.bak.zip.
